# assignmentB2CourtneyOsborne

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of assignmentB2CourtneyOsborne is to help statistians with visualisation of their data during preliminary data analysis.

## Installation

You can install the development version of assignmentB2CourtneyOsborne from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2CourtneyOsborne", ref = "0.1.0")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2CourtneyOsborne)
histogram(penguins, bill_len)
```
